notes: "Max DPS" now means the most damage possible in any style: main attacks only, spells, or both together, whichever is highest, after your minimums. It first finds the best spell-only and main-attack-only builds with full deep searches, then searches from those, so it never ends up below either. That takes about three times as long as a single search. It's the first goal in the form ("Most damage possible"), and what the bot uses when you ask for max DPS. Wynnbuilder's main-attack number is still there as "Main attack DPS only".
